from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OwnershipEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's ownership equity attributable to shareholders of the listed company for a reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities trading code")
    ownership_equity_attributable_to_listed_company_shareholders: float | None = Field(
        description="Ownership equity attributable to shareholders of the listed company (in CNY yuan)"
    )
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period the financial data covers")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the equity value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    ownership_equity_records: list[OwnershipEquityRecord]
